response.query: Which specific text‑and‑data‑mining (TDM) licenses and institutional approvals do we need, and what secure storage/retention policies will govern PDFs and any participant-level data?
response.answer: You need a specific text-and-data-mining license and institutional approvals from an ethics board. Secure storage and retention policies must govern PDFs and participant-level data, ensuring confidentiality and compliance with data protection laws.
